name: jira-moco
title: Jira MOCO Time Tracking
description: Track time on Jira issues with several timers and book it as Jira worklog and MOCO activity on the issue's job
author: mendyka

commands.name: track-time
commands.title: Track Time
commands.subtitle: Jira MOCO
commands.description: Find a Jira issue, start, pause and switch timers and book the time to Jira and MOCO

commands.name: toggle-timer
commands.title: Pause or Resume Timer
commands.subtitle: Jira MOCO
commands.description: Pauses the running timer or resumes the last one. With background refresh enabled, the subtitle shows the running timer.

commands.name: bookings
commands.title: Booked Time
commands.subtitle: Jira MOCO
commands.description: Bookings made with this extension: retry failed ones, undo, today's total in MOCO

commands.name: setup
commands.title: Set Up Jira and MOCO
commands.subtitle: Jira MOCO
commands.description: Connect Jira and MOCO and choose the fields holding job number and order

preferences.name: rounding
preferences.title: Round Booked Time
preferences.description: Timer durations are rounded up to this step when booking (you can still edit the duration)

preferences.name: singleRunning
preferences.title: Timers
preferences.label: Only one timer runs at a time
preferences.description: Starting or resuming a timer pauses the running one

preferences.name: jobPattern
preferences.title: Job Number Pattern
preferences.description: Optional regular expression applied to the job field. The first group (or the whole match) is the MOCO project number, e.g. P\d+ or \[(\w+)\] when the job is part of the summary.

preferences.name: orderPattern
preferences.title: Order Pattern
preferences.description: Optional regular expression applied to the order field. The first group (or the whole match) is compared with the MOCO task names.

preferences.name: notifyWatchers
preferences.title: Jira
preferences.label: Notify watchers about new worklogs
preferences.description: Jira sends an email to the issue's watchers for every worklog
